title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for next spring.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for next spring. It will be her first full tour of the region since she stepped away from the road, ending a period in which live work returned carefully through individual shows and festival appearances rather than another long itinerary. The new dates put a sustained run back on her calendar after the tour planned around *I'm Only F**king Myself* was cancelled.

The break began after she collapsed during her set at All Things Go in New York in September 2025. A few days later, she cancelled every upcoming performance for the foreseeable future, including the North American dates that had been due to follow the album. She said she needed time to work on herself and gave no timetable for returning. When she eventually spoke about performing again, the emphasis was on doing it gradually rather than rushing back into a full touring schedule.

The Grammys became one of the clearest signs that the return was gathering pace. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance, and she performed the song during the ceremony before resuming headline shows in the UK and moving back onto festival stages. She later returned to All Things Go itself, bringing her back to the festival where the previous run had come to an abrupt stop. By the time Everything Begins was announced, she had already spent months performing again without committing to another long North American tour.

[apple:song:6768357139:6768357142]

New music arrived in the middle of that process. "From Down Here," released in May and made with James Blake, came from an idea she says arrived the morning after her Grammy win. Young described the song as being about missing an old high while knowing that a more grounded life is safer and ultimately more rewarding. The track is calmer than much of *I'm Only F**king Myself* without losing the bluntness that made "Messy" connect, and it gives the new shows material written after the break rather than only songs from the album cycle that was interrupted by it.

Everything Begins takes its name from Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo, reversing a phrase that was already part of her story before the cancellations. In the note announcing her break, she asked fans for "a second chance" once she had taken time to work on herself. The months that followed were measured in individual performances rather than a replacement tour. Everything Begins is the first full North American run she has announced since that note.
